lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of discrete high-luminance centroids; density is highest in the anterior-most visible section posterior to the gills, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs along the mid-longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect horizontal blob rows, forming a faint rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature runs horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a distinct contrast boundary with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and lower luminance (shadowing) on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The caudal fin's lower lobe displays an irregular, non-symmetrical posterior edge, indicative of physical tissue truncation or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of numerous smaller organisms (commensal fish) clustered around the ventral and pectoral regions, creating localized occlusions and motion-blurred high-intensity artifacts against the shark's silhouette.
